settings.title: Black grounds the red.
settings.text: Black is the safest accent when the bag is already loud.

settings.title: White keeps it sharp.
settings.text: White works well as a clean contrast, especially in towels or small details.

settings.title: Navy makes it more athletic.
settings.text: Navy can soften a red bag and keep the setup from feeling too aggressive.

settings.title: Let red lead
settings.text: Red is already the statement color.

settings.title: Choose a quiet accent
settings.text: Black, white, or navy keeps the setup controlled.

settings.title: Skip extra highlights
settings.text: Avoid adding more loud colors. The bag already has the energy.

settings.heading: Build around a red bag.
settings.subheading: Red is bold by default. Keep the rest of the setup quiet, useful, and tightly matched.
